tools.name: prepare_review_comment
tools.description: Live-read all issue comments and prepare one review-findings update. Returns a preview and a session-local plan reference. Does not write.

tools.name: apply_review_comment
tools.description: Apply the exact stored review comment once. Accepts only the prepared reference. Refuses stale, expired or reused plans. An uncertain write must be checked before any further write.

plan_ref.description: Reference returned by prepare_review_comment in this session

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Report the outcome once the operation is complete or cannot proceed. No further tool calls are accepted afterwards.
